bibl.title: The Currency Reforms and Character of Ptolemy I Soter.
bibl.seg: Catherine Lorber, The Currency Reforms and Character of Ptolemy I Soter.
Timothy Howe (ed.), Ptolemy I Soter: A Self-Made Man (Oxford, 2018) pp. 60-87, figg.
bibl.note: First reform: The imposition of Alexander's coinage. - Second reform: The introduction of Alexander's coin portrait. - Third reform: A new reverse type for the silver coinage. - Fourth reform: The abandonment of the Attic weight standard. - Fifth reform: The creation of a new type of gold stater. - Sixth reform: A completely new personal coinage. - Conclusions.
